fills.researcher_notes: Same company-level Operator question as P0271 and P3296 -- resolved once for the whole Transco brief per gotcha 4, see full reasoning on P0271. Appalachian Connector (aka Western Marcellus Pipeline) was itself proposed and abandoned by Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Company, LLC as an extension of the same Transco system these two sources identify (Marcellus Drilling News' 2014 coverage, 'Yet Another Williams Transco Expansion: Western Marcellus Project', names Transco as the proposer) -- the operator identity does not change because the specific project never advanced; it is the same company operating the mainline this project would have tied into.
